releases.notes:
## Party Pulse 1.0.4

### Fixes
- **Bug:** Your Damage Done / Healing meters could jump to another player's full server total when you first saw them (login, meet-up, or first stats packet). That was wrong. Fixed.
- Meter now waits for their first stats packet, then only counts damage/healing from that point forward for you.

### Notes
- Also for players on **Prominence II 4.0.1hf** (and 4.0.x) running Party Pulse with the pack.
- Install `party-pulse-1.0.4.jar` on **client and server**.

GitHub: https://github.com/cjayride/party-pulse/releases/tag/v1.0.4

## Party Pulse 1.0.3

### Fixes
- Party health no longer shows fake **20 HP** when teammates are in another dimension or far away (outside entity range)
- Prefer **server-synced** health / max health for party frames
- Thread-safe health sync maps
- Party refresh now pushes all players' stats and health to you

### Notes
- Combat metrics (Damage / DPS / Healing / HPS) still freeze outside the 128-block range by design; HP frames keep updating
- Install on **client and server**

### Install
`party-pulse-1.0.3.jar` — Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric

GitHub: https://github.com/cjayride/party-pulse/releases/tag/v1.0.3

## Party Pulse 1.0.2

### Fixes
- Compatible with **Prominence II 4.0** — no longer conflicts with Prominent's Spell Engine heal `@Redirect` (priest-set heal hook)
- Spell Engine Healing Done still credits the caster via Inject + ThreadLocal instead of a competing Redirect

### Notes
- Recommended for Prominence II 4.0 and earlier Spell Engine packs
- Legacy redirect-based build: **1.0.1** (not for 4.0)

### Install
`party-pulse-1.0.2.jar` on **client and server**.

releases.notes:
## Party Pulse 1.0.1

### Fixes
- Healing Done / HPS now records **all effective healing** (no overheal), not only Spell Engine casts
- Death Knight self-heals (e.g. Death Strike) now count
- Health flasks / potions now count
- Food / saturation regen now counts

Spell Engine heals still credit the **caster**. Other `heal()` sources credit the healed player.

### Install
Upload/install `party-pulse-1.0.1.jar` on **client and server**.

releases.notes:
## Party Pulse 1.0.0

Initial public release for **Fabric Minecraft 1.20.1**.

### Install
- Drop `party-pulse-1.0.0.jar` into `mods` on **client and server**
- Requires Fabric API
- Optional: Spell Engine, Open Parties and Claims, Trinkets

### Highlights
- Party frames with live health
- Damage / DPS / Healing / HPS metrics
- `/pulse` commands and Ctrl hotkeys
- Configurable HUD via `/pulse menu`

Upload the same jar to CurseForge / Modrinth; this GitHub release is for source-adjacent reference downloads.
